card.name: Molecular biology terms and journal abbreviations
card.fires_on: Words inside molecular biology names, like Molecular, polymerase, chain, and the period in the abbreviation Mol. Biol. Evol. It is strongest in citations and genetics texts.

modes.label: Journal abbreviation
modes.description: The period after Mol or Biol in a journal title such as Mol. Biol. Evol.

modes.label: Molecular as a word
modes.description: The word Molecular or molecular before biology, genetic, or phylogenetics.
